headline: GitLab Foundation announces second Powering Economic Opportunity funding round
summary: GitLab Foundation and Families and Workers Fund announced a second Powering Economic Opportunity round with a $4 million pool and grants capped at $500,000, distinct from their two-year $16 million partnership. Concept notes closed August 12, 2026; invited proposals proceed through fall review with awards expected in early December, and the program page requires an active employer, union, association or industry partner.
